meta.sources_note: Expansion batch 28 (DECISIONS 050, continuous expansion per DECISIONS 027, no per-batch approval): 5 new Garmin models, 10 quotes, 4 identifiers verified (vivoactive 6 UPC 753759342807 / MPN 010-02985-00; Venu 4 45mm UPC 753759342883 / MPN 010-03014-01; Forerunner 570 42mm UPC 753759349820 / MPN 010-02970-02; Edge 1050 UPC 753759336288 / MPN 010-02890-00), 1 stays pending (fenix 9 47mm — MPN 010-04762-00 confirmed by Garmin US + Abt + RA Cycles, no UPC surfaced). Garmin US store pages read fresh 2026-11-06 ~21:21 UTC (13:21 PT): vivoactive 6 $299.99 JSON-LD, Venu 4 45mm $549.99 JSON-LD (pinned Silver/Silver Gray variant), Forerunner 570 42mm $549.99 JSON-LD, Edge 1050 $699.99 JSON-LD, fenix 9 47mm $999.99 JSON-LD (pinned Titanium/Pebble Gray variant). Meta Catalog CLI run 2026-11-06 (20 rows per model; raw files data/meta_catalog_raw_{vivoactive-6,venu-4-45mm,forerunner-570-42mm,edge-1050,fenix-9-47mm}_2026-11-06.json). Brand-direct prices verified read-only 2026-11-06 ~21:21 UTC: no sign-in, no cart, no purchase. No Amazon touch: no Amazon quotes, no Amazon-sourced prices or identifiers in the snapshot (Amazon item details were read only as a third corroboration for the Forerunner 570 UPC, which is verified on Target US + Selenal.lv without it). Stock caveats recorded in catalog notes: vivoactive 6 Temporarily Out of Stock at Dell (Garmin page states no stock flag); no stock confirmation on the other four Garmin pages. Price traps caught and excluded (see catalog notes): Venu 4 leather-band variant $599.99 (010-03014-03, different variant) and Venu 4 bundles $554.99-$560.99 (bundles, not device-only); Forerunner 570 47mm (different size, same $549.99) and the $563 third-party row; Edge 1050 sensor bundle 010-02890-01 (different MPN/EAN, $713.99 Best Buy bundle rows); fenix 9 Pro lines $1,099.99-$1,249.99 and Carbon Gray DLC Titanium 010-04762-10 $1,049.99 (different models/variants); vivoactive 6 $341-$342 non-US rows (different market). Skipped this batch, list-only: Forerunner 970 47mm Carbon Gray DLC Titanium 010-02969-00 ($749.99 — UPC conflicted: Amazon item details + Snapklik say 753759349929, a single eBay listing says 753759349899, and the -01 variant is likewise conflicted, Abt 753759349905 vs Snapklik 753759349936 — needs a dedicated tiebreak, e.g. Best Buy specs or a box barcode, before any code is recorded); Edge 1060 ($799.99, launched Oct 20, 2026 — too new for UPC verification; re-check once retailer UPC fields populate); Fenix 8 47mm AMOLED (superseded by the fenix 9, now discounted last-gen); Instinct 3, Forerunner 165, Edge 850, Garmin dash cams (not yet swept).
